Invalidation of CAN hardware object, provide CPU access to CAN mailbox The CPU (CanDrv) get exclusive access rights to the CAN mailbox or at least to the corresponding hardware object, where new data were received. Buffering, normalizing The L-PDU is normalized and is buffered in the temporary buffer located in CanDrv. Each CanDrv owns such a temporary buffer for every Physical Channel only if normalizing of the data is necessary. Indication to CanIf The reception is indicated to CanIf by calling of CanIf_ RxIndication().
